top_stories.title: Passkey attacks turn Windows logs and Chrome memory into MFA bypass paths
top_stories.summary: Researchers have identified three new attack techniques that bypass passkey-based MFA by exploiting weaknesses in Windows event logs, Chrome browser memory, and cloud identity services. Microsoft has issued a patch for the Windows logging vulnerability, while the browser and cloud identity attack vectors remain areas of active concern.

top_stories.title: Microsoft Entra makes passkeys default as SMS and voice MFA face retirement
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Entra will make passkeys the default authentication method on September 1, 2026, automatically enabling them for users currently relying on SMS or voice MFA. Microsoft-provided SMS and voice MFA will be fully retired on February 1, 2027, requiring administrators to migrate users to alternative authentication methods before that deadline.

top_stories.title: 153GB of stolen credentials surface after LiteLLM supply chain attack
top_stories.summary: A 153GB archive of stolen credentials exposed during a LiteLLM supply chain attack has surfaced, containing 433,909 files and 118,829 CI runner dumps linked to 2,488 corporate domains including AWS, Samsung, Cisco, and Salesforce. Hudson Rock obtained and analyzed the archive and is conducting a global ethical disclosure effort to notify affected organizations.

top_stories.title: AWS IAM now provides role manager to set up IAM roles automatically
top_stories.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of role manager, a new capability in AWS IAM that automatically creates the IAM roles required by AWS services during console setup. The feature eliminates manual role configuration by automatically provisioning the necessary roles when a supported service is configured.

top_stories.title: CaptiveCrunch: Midnight Blizzard Weaponizes Hotel Wi-Fi Captive Portals to Steal Microsoft 365 Credentials
top_stories.summary: Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported an ongoing credential theft campaign called CaptiveCrunch, attributed to Russian state-sponsored group Midnight Blizzard (APT29), targeting Microsoft 365 credentials via malicious hotel Wi-Fi captive portals. The campaign is tracked as Storm-2945 and specifically focuses on stealing M365 authentication credentials from hotel guests.

news.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
news.summary: Belgium's national eID authentication system was found to contain severe vulnerabilities in a critical browser extension that fully compromised its trust framework. The flaws exposed citizen accounts to remote code execution (RCE), highlighting systemic security risks in browser extension-based identity and authentication mechanisms.

news.title: Attackers exploit critical SharePoint flaw after PoC goes public (CVE-2026-55040)
news.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-55040, a critical Microsoft SharePoint authentication bypass vulnerability, following public release of proof-of-concept exploit code by Rapid7. The flaw allows attackers to impersonate users, disclose files, and modify data, and was patched by Microsoft in its July 2026 Patch Tuesday updates.

news.title: Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
news.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-55040, a critical Microsoft SharePoint authentication bypass vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1, following public release of proof-of-concept code. The flaw stems from weak authentication mechanisms and was patched by Microsoft in its July 2026 Patch Tuesday updates.

news.title: Malicious LiteLLM Releases Tied to Trivy Hack May Have Exposed 2,100+ Organizations
news.summary: Two malicious LiteLLM releases containing credential-stealing code were published to PyPI for approximately 40 minutes in March, capable of harvesting cloud keys, SSH keys, Kubernetes tokens, and database passwords. A dataset obtained by CloudSEK built from roughly 434,000 captured files indicates potential exposure across 2,100+ organizations.

news.title: How AWS IAM role manager rethinks the starting point for IAM roles
news.summary: AWS has introduced an IAM role manager tool that rethinks how developers start with IAM roles when building new applications or capabilities on Amazon Web Services. The tool aims to simplify the process of configuring IAM roles for AWS services that act on a user's behalf, addressing a common friction point in cloud identity and access management.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities in firewalls and VPN appliances while bypassing MFA to attack critical infrastructure targets. The operation uses leaked Conti ransomware code and leverages unpatched flaws to gain unauthorized access.

news.title: Researchers Disclose AI-Assisted SharePoint Exploit Chain Reaching Unauthenticated RCE
news.summary: Security researchers disclosed a critical exploit chain (CVE-2026-55040, CVSS 9.1) enabling unauthenticated remote code execution on Microsoft SharePoint Server by bypassing authentication to access servers as any user, including administrators. The flaw affects SharePoint Server Subscription Edition, 2019, and 2016, with part of the discovery attributed to AI-assisted research.

news.title: Malicious MCP Servers Can Split Instructions to Make AI Coding Agents Exfiltrate Secrets
news.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that malicious Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers can manipulate AI coding assistants into exfiltrating secrets such as SSH keys and environment variables by splitting harmful instructions into innocuous-looking fragments. The attack method bypasses safety refusals by distributing the malicious request across multiple channels the AI assistant already monitors, raising concerns about credential and secret theft in AI-assisted development environments.

news.title: Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance: multi-tenant administration and drift monitoring
news.summary: Microsoft Entra Tenant Governance has reached general availability, targeting organizations that manage multiple Microsoft Entra tenants. The feature set includes tenant discovery, cross-tenant delegated administration, configuration monitoring, and controlled creation of add-on capabilities.

news.title: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Jenkins and SonarQube
news.summary: AWS Secrets Manager has extended its managed external secrets capability to support automatic rotation of Jenkins API Tokens and SonarQube Tokens. This update allows users to rotate these third-party credentials directly from the AWS console without writing custom rotation code.

news.title: Cisco Secure Access for Government Achieves FedRAMP Certified Class D (High)
news.summary: Cisco Secure Access for Government has achieved FedRAMP Certified Class D (High) authorization, meeting federal compliance standards for sensitive data and DoD environments. The certification covers the product's Zero Trust security capabilities for federal agencies.

news.title: Microsoft: FruitStone gives Midnight Blizzard a control panel for hotel Wi-Fi attacks
news.summary: Microsoft has uncovered FruitStone, a web-based control panel used by Russian threat actor Midnight Blizzard to manage the CaptiveCrunch campaign, which hijacks hotel captive-portal Wi-Fi networks to target travelers. The attack delivers CornFlake and ChocoShell malware through compromised network authentication portals, making it directly relevant to IAM professionals concerned with network access security and captive portal vulnerabilities.

news.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
news.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by manipulating security alerts and blocked events to hijack agent behavior. The findings highlight weaknesses in how AI agents handle authentication and authorization decisions, raising concerns about identity governance frameworks as organizations deploy agentic AI systems.

news.title: AWS Identity and Access Management streamlines assignment of IAM roles to workforce users with account access manager
news.summary: AWS IAM launched a new feature called account access manager that streamlines the assignment of IAM roles to workforce users across AWS accounts. Administrators can use the feature to assign IAM roles in their AWS accounts directly to workforce users, simplifying role management workflows.

news.title: Microsoft unveils Project Perception in July 2026 Security update
news.summary: Microsoft's July 2026 Security update introduces Project Perception, an agentic defense platform that continuously identifies, investigates, and remediates threats. The release includes AI-focused protections specifically covering identities among other areas such as email and cloud agents.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian threat actor Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges related to hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved unauthorized access to Snowflake customer accounts, largely enabled by stolen credentials and the absence of multi-factor authentication on victim accounts.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA issued a postmortem report on a data breach in which a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident was reported by KrebsOnSecurity before CISA was notified, highlighting gaps in credential monitoring and secrets management practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to an August 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise enterprise systems.
